description: Canonical registry of software tools, platforms, APIs, and cloud services across Nova Skills curricula, defining access models, free-tier limits, student cost responsibilities, and zero-cost alternatives.
principles: Zero mandatory software expenses beyond the approved course tuition fee.
Every required assignment and portfolio capstone must be 100% completable using free tiers, open-source software, student licenses, or institute-provided environments.
Optional premium tools must be clearly identified as non-mandatory with zero-cost alternatives provided in class.
Usage-based APIs must include cost minimization techniques (local mock testing, token caching, free tiers).

Free Tier.description: Vendor offers a permanent or generous free tier sufficient for all student learning, assignments, and portfolio deliverables.

No Additional Cost.description: Open-source software or community edition software freely downloadable and usable without commercial licensing constraints.

Institute Provided.description: Hardware, specialized lab equipment, or shared software environments provided directly by Nova Skills during supervised classroom or lab hours.

Included Licensed Access.description: Software licenses or premium seats provisioned directly by Nova Skills for the duration of the course.

Trial Access.description: Vendor provides an official free trial (7 to 30 days) or student sandbox utilized during the active module. Open-source or free-tier alternatives are provided for ongoing practice.
Trial Access.studentCost: ₹0 during trial; zero-cost alternatives provided thereafter

Optional Premium.description: Premium or commercial subscription tier that offers convenience or higher speed, but is NOT required to complete assignments or graduate.

Usage-Based API.description: Cloud API services billed per token or call (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic). Free alternatives (Google AI Studio, Ollama) are taught as the primary foundation; minimal spend applies only if student opts for commercial model volume.
Usage-Based API.studentCost: ₹0 (Free tier primary); optional ₹200–₹1,500 if deploying commercial frontier models

Student Subscription Required.description: Software requiring a personal student license. Nova Skills policy requires providing a verified zero-cost alternative for every curriculum requirement.

Shared Classroom Access.description: Shared workstation licenses, test benches, or physical devices provided on-campus or during supervised lab sessions.

Pending Verification.description: Commercial licensing status pending institutional vendor agreement verification. Must NOT be advertised as included in tuition.

pillar1_tuitionInclusions.title: Included in Tuition
pillar1_tuitionInclusions.description: Core institutional provisions covered 100% by your course fee.
items: Live interactive instructor-led classes and hands-on lab sessions
Personal code reviews, portfolio evaluations, and capstone grading
Verified Nova Skills Certificate of Completion with secure QR verification
LMS archive access to all class recordings, slide decks, and code repos
Dedicated 1-on-1 career counselling, resume audits, and mock interviews
Lifetime access to the Nova Skills alumni network and community Discord

pillar2_freeTools.title: Free Tools & Student Accounts (₹0 Additional Cost)
pillar2_freeTools.description: All mandatory portfolio projects can be completed entirely using robust free tiers, open-source software, and student accounts.
pillar2_freeTools.guarantee: Zero hidden tool fees required to graduate or build your production portfolio.

pillar3_optionalPremium.title: Optional Premium Services
pillar3_optionalPremium.description: Advanced productivity tools that students may choose to explore. Never mandatory; full zero-cost equivalents are demonstrated in every module.

pillar4_usageBasedExpenses.title: Usage-Based & External Expenses
pillar4_usageBasedExpenses.description: External third-party costs (such as custom domain names or commercial API volume) that arise only if a student chooses to deploy live personal commercial projects.

Python.freeTierDetails: Open-source, 100% free under Python Software Foundation License.
Python.notes: Standard primary language for AI, data science, and backend development.

Visual Studio Code.freeTierDetails: Open-source editor by Microsoft, 100% free for all personal and commercial use.
Visual Studio Code.notes: Includes full ecosystem of free extensions (Python, Pylance, Ruff, GitLens).

Git and GitHub.freeTierDetails: Git is open-source (₹0). GitHub Free provides unlimited public and private repositories, GitHub Pages hosting, and 2,000 CI/CD Action minutes/month.
Git and GitHub.notes: GitHub Student Developer Pack offers additional developer tools at zero cost.

Google AI Studio.freeTierDetails: Generous free tier offering Gemini 2.0 Flash and 1.5 Pro API keys with high rate limits for prototyping and development.
Google AI Studio.notes: Primary AI API used across AI engineering and prompt engineering courses.

Ollama.freeTierDetails: 100% open-source local inference engine for running open-weights models offline.
Ollama.notes: Enables 100% offline, zero-cost development with Llama 3.3, Mistral, and Qwen models.

Docker.freeTierDetails: Docker Community Edition (Docker CE) and Docker Desktop for personal/educational use is 100% free.
Docker.notes: Used for containerizing FastAPI backends, n8n, PostgreSQL, and vector stores.

PostgreSQL & pgvector.freeTierDetails: PostgreSQL and pgvector extension are 100% open-source. Free local installation via Docker or native binary.
PostgreSQL & pgvector.notes: Production vector search and relational database foundation.

Supabase.freeTierDetails: Free plan includes 500MB database, 1GB storage, 50,000 monthly active users, and built-in pgvector.

n8n.freeTierDetails: n8n Community Edition is self-hosted via Docker at ₹0 with unlimited workflow executions.
n8n.notes: Primary enterprise automation platform taught across AI automation courses.

FastAPI.freeTierDetails: Open-source async web framework under MIT License.

Vercel.freeTierDetails: Hobby plan provides free hosting for frontend and serverless applications with automatic SSL and preview URLs.
Vercel.zeroCostAlternative: Netlify Free, GitHub Pages, Render Free Tier
Vercel.notes: Free *.vercel.app staging URLs cover 100% of student deployment needs.

Render.freeTierDetails: Free tier for web services and static sites with automatic HTTPS and Git deploys.
Render.zeroCostAlternative: Railway Free Trial, Hugging Face Spaces, Fly.io
Render.notes: Used for hosting FastAPI backend services.

Figma.freeTierDetails: Free Starter plan covers 3 Figma and 3 FigJam files. Free Figma Education plan provides full professional features to students upon verification.
Figma.notes: Standard UI design and wireframing tool.

Canva.freeTierDetails: Canva Free provides 250,000+ templates, 1M+ free photos/graphics, and basic AI Magic Studio features.
Canva.notes: Used for social media creatives and marketing collaterals.

Blender.freeTierDetails: 100% free and open-source under GNU GPL. Complete 3D creation suite (modeling, rigging, animation, rendering).

DaVinci Resolve.freeTierDetails: DaVinci Resolve standard edition by Blackmagic Design is 100% free forever for Mac and Windows.
DaVinci Resolve.notes: No watermark, exports up to 4K Ultra HD. Resolve Studio (paid) is NOT required for coursework.

Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Premier.freeTierDetails: Adobe provides official 7-day free trials. Students also qualify for Adobe Creative Cloud Student discounts (~₹1,500/mo).
Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Premier.estimatedStudentCost: ₹0 during trial; educational discount optional; zero-cost alternatives provided in class
Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Premier.zeroCostAlternative: Photopea (Photoshop alternative, ₹0), DaVinci Resolve (Premiere Pro alternative, ₹0), Inkscape (Illustrator alternative, ₹0), Blender / Natron (After Effects alternative, ₹0)
Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Premier.notes: Nova Skills does not bundle paid Adobe CC commercial licenses into tuition. Every assignment accepts work produced on verified zero-cost alternatives.

OpenAI API (GPT-4o, Responses API).freeTierDetails: Free usage via Google AI Studio Gemini API covers core principles. OpenAI API is pay-as-you-go with credit tier.
OpenAI API (GPT-4o, Responses API).estimatedStudentCost: ₹0 using Google AI Studio; optional ₹200–₹500 for OpenAI developer credits if desired
OpenAI API (GPT-4o, Responses API).zeroCostAlternative: Google AI Studio (Gemini 2.0 Flash, ₹0), Ollama local models (₹0)
OpenAI API (GPT-4o, Responses API).notes: Labs use structured output schemas compatible across both Gemini and OpenAI.

Anthropic Claude API.freeTierDetails: Claude 3.5 Sonnet free on claude.ai for prompt testing. API usage is pay-as-you-go.
Anthropic Claude API.estimatedStudentCost: ₹0 using Claude.ai free web tier; optional ₹200–₹500 for API testing
Anthropic Claude API.zeroCostAlternative: Google Gemini 1.5 Pro / 2.0 Flash via AI Studio (₹0)
Anthropic Claude API.notes: Used for frontier code analysis and long-context synthesis.

Cursor.freeTierDetails: Free plan includes 2,000 completions and 50 slow premium requests/month. 14-day free trial of Cursor Pro.
Cursor.zeroCostAlternative: VS Code + GitHub Copilot Student Pack (Free) or VS Code + Continue / Cline extension with free Gemini API
Cursor.notes: Cursor Pro is completely optional. All coding exercises are 100% executable in standard VS Code.

ChatGPT Plus / Claude Pro.freeTierDetails: ChatGPT Free (GPT-4o mini + limited GPT-4o) and Claude.ai Free tier cover all required classroom exercises.
ChatGPT Plus / Claude Pro.zeroCostAlternative: ChatGPT Free, Claude.ai Free, Google Gemini Free
ChatGPT Plus / Claude Pro.notes: Subscriptions are never required. Syllabus is designed for cross-platform free model access.

Midjourney.freeTierDetails: No permanent free tier on Midjourney Discord.
Midjourney.estimatedStudentCost: Optional (/month); zero-cost alternatives provided for all assignments
Midjourney.zeroCostAlternative: Leonardo.ai (150 free tokens/day), Adobe Firefly (25 free generative credits/month), Canva Magic Studio (50 free credits), Stable Diffusion / ComfyUI local (₹0)
Midjourney.notes: Course assignments explicitly accept deliverables from Leonardo.ai, Firefly, or local Stable Diffusion.

Google Search Console & Google Analytics.freeTierDetails: 100% free by Google with no time limit or volume cap for student/business sites.
Google Search Console & Google Analytics.notes: Core tools for SEO and digital marketing courses.

Looker Studio.freeTierDetails: 100% free by Google for creating interactive dashboards and client reporting.
Looker Studio.notes: Used across Digital Marketing and Performance Marketing academies.

WordPress.freeTierDetails: WordPress open-source CMS is 100% free. Practiced locally via LocalWP (₹0) or free staging environments.
WordPress.notes: No live hosting purchase required to learn and build production WordPress sites.

Shopify.freeTierDetails: Shopify Partners Program provides 100% free, unlimited development stores for learning and client staging.
Shopify.zeroCostAlternative: WooCommerce on WordPress (100% free open-source e-commerce)
Shopify.notes: Students build complete e-commerce stores on Shopify Partners at ₹0.

Webflow.freeTierDetails: Webflow Starter plan provides 2 unhosted staging sites on webflow.io subdomain with full design capabilities.
Webflow.zeroCostAlternative: Framer Free plan, Carrd Free plan
Webflow.notes: Staging sites on *.webflow.io subdomain are 100% free for portfolio builds.

Framer.freeTierDetails: Free plan includes unlimited free staging sites on *.framer.media subdomain with 1,000 visitors/month.
Framer.notes: Tuition covers hosting on free *.framer.media subdomains. Custom domain (~₹800/yr) is optional.

BBC micro:bit & Sensor Hardware.freeTierDetails: Classroom hardware kits provided during supervised offline training. Online students utilize official Microsoft MakeCode micro:bit simulator (100% free).
BBC micro:bit & Sensor Hardware.notes: Hardware access is fully provided in classroom labs.

Custom Domain Name.freeTierDetails: Free subdomains provided via Vercel (*.vercel.app), Netlify (*.netlify.app), GitHub Pages (*.github.io), Framer (*.framer.media).
Custom Domain Name.estimatedStudentCost: Optional ₹700–₹1,000/year if student wishes to purchase personal custom domain (.com/.in)
Custom Domain Name.zeroCostAlternative: Free staging subdomains on Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages, Framer
Custom Domain Name.notes: Never mandatory for portfolio grading. Custom domain purchase is at student discretion.
